response_summary: Late-recorded verification: confirmed owner/coordinator authorization, exact branch/base equality, and NEXUS/TUSKER semantic acceptance with transport/API and runtime integration still blocked; no code changes in that response.

AEGIS-06-RUNTIME-001: implemented isolated deny-by-default policy, exact-bound approval lifecycle, SQLite atomic one-time consume/reconciliation, narrow broker authorization gate, HMAC audit and adversarial tests; 10 runtime tests passed locally; privileged NEXUS dispatch remains disabled.

Added externally retained HMAC audit checkpoints and rollback/truncation verification with adversarial regression coverage; prior runtime head passed 174 security tests in GitHub CI and unified validation; checkpoint regression test awaits CI.

Closed an authorization-state disclosure gap by binding consume reconciliation to the original authenticated principal, session and device; added cross-identity regression coverage and verified both security and unified CI.

Hardened policy resource resolution against dropped, added or widened resources; action digest now binds both caller-requested resource identifiers and resolver-canonical identifiers; added adversarial regression tests.

Closed a consume replay disclosure gap by checking authenticated principal, session and device bindings before returning ALREADY_CONSUMED or a consumption ID; added regression coverage for all three mismatches and verified both security and unified CI.

Bound canonical resource IDs returned by the policy resource resolver to 1,024 characters, fail-closed on oversized resolver output, added a regression test, and verified both security and unified CI.
Escalated executable-resource operations to R4 approval risk, added a policy regression assertion, and aligned the runtime security documentation.

Made registry resource declarations fail closed when malformed or ambiguous: rejects duplicate resource kinds, duplicate or unknown access modes, empty access lists, and unexpected declaration fields; added parameterized regression coverage.

Hardened trusted registry identity scope validation: allowed origins must be unique members of the trusted origin set; principal-class lists must contain unique bounded strings; malformed authenticated principal classes are rejected. Added 12 adversarial regression cases.

Hardened registry numeric and shape validation: explicitly reject Python booleans for timeout/input-byte integer limits, reject malformed registry sequences and non-mapping entries before lookup, and bound policy/registry version identifiers; added four adversarial regression cases.

Aligned defensive operation-registration validation with the complete v0.1.0 schema contract: required fields, property allowlist, identifier/version bounds, resource/precondition limits, rate-limit shape, risk-escalation shape, and approval/risk constraints; updated fixtures, added eleven malformed-entry regression cases, and documented that shape validation does not replace signature trust.

Fixed operation-registration semantic-version regex and validate every signed registry entry before action lookup; added regression coverage proving malformed unrelated entries invalidate the registry.

Hardened HMAC audit-chain verification to reject non-integer/bool checkpoint sequences and SQLite sequence gaps or renumbering even when event payload hashes remain valid; added adversarial regression coverage and documented the invariant.

Closed the empty-chain audit checkpoint ambiguity: sequence-zero checkpoints must carry the fixed all-zero genesis hash even when their MAC is otherwise valid; added a forged-MAC regression test and documented the invariant.

Hardened external audit checkpoint creation to verify the complete local HMAC chain before signing; corrupted or sequence-invalid database state now raises SecurityStoreError instead of receiving a fresh trusted checkpoint. Added adversarial regression coverage and documented the fail-closed behavior.

Aligned consume authorization-reference validation with reconciliation: enforce a 1–512 character bound and strict UTF-8, fail closed on malformed references, and add regression coverage proving rejected values do not mutate authorization state; both required CI workflows passed on the exact code head.

Closed a policy resource-scope gap: proposals with zero concrete resources now fail closed with POLICY_SCOPE_EXCEEDED instead of reaching resolver/precondition evaluation; added regression coverage and verified both required CI workflows on the exact code head.

Made audit checkpoint creation snapshot-consistent: chain verification and tip capture now run inside one SQLite read transaction, preventing concurrent appends from racing the checkpoint. Existing caller transactions are rejected without being committed or rolled back; added regression coverage and documentation.

Hardened authorization consumption so caller-supplied audit context must match the stored approval and independently authenticated peer: principal, proposal, fixed operation, risk, policy, action digest, task/step, registry version/status and origin. Remote device/session audit bindings must match authenticated peer data. Mismatches fail closed without consuming the reference or appending an audit event; added adversarial regression cases and documented the boundary. Security CI passed 229 tests and unified validation passed all eight jobs.

Hardened the audit read/export boundary: audit_events now verifies the complete HMAC chain and retrieves event rows within the same SQLite read snapshot, refusing corrupted chains and caller-owned active transactions; added tamper and transaction-preservation regression tests and documented the fail-closed contract.

Hardened audit timestamp validation: timestamp_utc now requires a bounded ISO-8601 string with an explicit zero UTC offset; timezone-naive and non-UTC offsets fail closed. Added parameterized regression tests and documented the timestamp contract.

Hardened audit event schema validation: retained scalar fields now have explicit type and size bounds, malformed enum/identity values and nested optional transaction data fail closed, and regression tests cover hostile field shapes.

Hardened approval decisions to accept only actual booleans; truthy/falsy coercions now return INVALID_DECISION before authentication or state mutation. Added adversarial tests proving the approval remains PENDING and the audit chain receives no extra event.

Bound approval-creation audit context to the persisted authority record across principal, proposal, operation, risk, policy, action digest, task/step and registry fields; added ten adversarial tests proving mismatches fail before approval or audit persistence. Both required CI workflows passed on the exact validated branch head.

Tightened audit and approval identifier parsing to require canonical lowercase UUID text for proposal, decision and approval-reference IDs, preventing alternate textual encodings from entering signed audit records or approval storage; added regression tests for uppercase, braced, compact and non-string identifiers.

Bound authorization issuance audit context to the persisted approval, including principal, proposal, operation, risk, policy, action digest, task/step, registry and remote device/session identity. Mismatches now roll back before authorization-reference creation; adversarial tests prove approval remains approved, no auth reference is issued and no audit event is appended. Security contract validation and all eight unified validation jobs passed on the exact code head.

Bound approval decision audit events to the persisted approval's principal, proposal, operation, risk, policy, action digest, task/step and registry bindings; remote device/session audit identity must match the stored approval binding. Added adversarial mismatch cases proving invalid context leaves approval PENDING and appends no audit event. Security contract validation and all eight unified validation jobs passed on the subsequent exact branch head.

Hardened the SQLite security-state database file boundary: database files are created/opened with owner-only 0600 permissions, existing permissive modes are tightened before SQLite opens the file, non-regular files are rejected, and final-component symlinks are refused. Added tests for creation, reopening, permission repair and symlink rejection.

Hardened security callback contracts to require literal boolean True: approver authentication no longer accepts truthy non-booleans, and policy re-evaluation at authorization issuance and consume fails closed on coercible truthy values. Added 12 adversarial parameterized cases proving unauthorized callbacks cannot approve, issue, or consume authorization. Security contract validation and all eight unified validation jobs passed on exact head c1ef847e82aeeb3800774447dadd949bc2d72f51.

Closed a SQLite database path-swap race during store initialization: keep the no-follow file descriptor open while SQLite connects, compare device/inode identity before any PRAGMA or schema writes, and fail closed on path replacement. Added a race-injection symlink regression test proving the redirected database remains untouched. Both required CI workflows passed on exact head 3a7a5ae242d454829df8c6c53e471a60144cac70.

Rejected multiply-linked SQLite security database files before chmod or SQLite writes, preventing another pathname from exposing or mutating approval, authorization and audit state. Added a regression proving a hard-linked external file remains byte-for-byte and permission-identical after rejection; documented the invariant.

Rejected empty, bytes-valued and NUL-containing SQLite database paths before connecting. Empty SQLite filenames can create temporary, non-durable databases; the new fail-closed validation requires an explicit non-empty string path, with :memory: remaining an explicit test-only choice. Added parameterized constructor regressions.
